## Shared Keybinds

[<code>disable_default_key_bindings = true</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/init.lua#L202)

| Key | Action | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <code>CTRL+SHIFT+Tab</code> | [<code>tmux.dispatch("p", act.ActivateTabRelative(-1))</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/init.lua#L66) | Tmux: Previous window; WezTerm: Activate Tab Relative: -1 |
| <code>CTRL+Tab</code> | [<code>tmux.dispatch("n", act.ActivateTabRelative(1))</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/init.lua#L61) | Tmux: Next window; WezTerm: Activate Tab Relative: 1 |
| <code>CTRL+l</code> | [<code>act.SendKey({ key = "l", mods = "CTRL" })</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/init.lua#L108) | Send Key |
| <code>CTRL+{ Up = { streak = 1, button = "Left" } }</code> | [<code>wezterm.action.OpenLinkAtMouseCursor</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/mouse-bindings.lua#L8) | Open Link At Mouse Cursor<br><code>mouse</code> |
| <code>SHIFT+Enter</code> | [<code>shift_enter</code>](../../shared/wezterm/keymap/motion-keys.lua#L35) | Shift enter |
